agenda.title: Reconcile anchor and challenge conditions
agenda.deliverable: Updated condition register with source locators for workload, hardware/process, baseline, metric, budget, limits, and explicit unknowns.
acceptance: Every anchor and challenge paper has a condition record or an explicit source-access failure record.
Unknown fields remain unknown; description-tier values are not upgraded to full-paper evidence.
The direction review gate is regenerated and counts match the condition register.

agenda.title: Audit counterpressure and boundary cases
agenda.deliverable: One auditable challenge record per canonical direction, with relation type, failure condition, and what observation would weaken the hypothesis.
acceptance: All six directions have a role=challenge record.
Each challenge has source tier, condition status, limits, and a source locator or documented gap.
No challenge is counted as independent validation of the supporting direction.

agenda.title: Obtain independent source-entailment review
agenda.deliverable: Two independent verdicts per selected review packet, disagreement resolution, and preserved reviewer rationale.
acceptance: Reviewer judgments are independent of the researcher coding and each other until disagreement resolution.
Every accepted material claim has a source-entailment verdict and unresolved objections are retained.
The gate count changes only from recorded verdicts, never from deterministic preflight.

agenda.title: Run matched cross-conference mechanism comparisons
agenda.deliverable: Matched comparison tables for each direction using equivalent workloads/design suites, hardware/process, baselines, metrics, budgets, and validity boundaries.
acceptance: Every comparison states its population and missingness denominators.
Proxy metrics are not presented as end-to-end benefit without an explicit boundary argument.
Contradictory or incomparable records are retained as such rather than ranked.

agenda.title: Promote, split, weaken, or abandon direction hypotheses
agenda.deliverable: Edition-comparable snapshots and a direction verdict at capability, persistence, prevalence, or impact level.
acceptance: At least two comparable editions use the same taxonomy and disclosed evidence tiers.
Inventory, source-text, coded, condition-complete, and independently reviewed denominators are reported.
The claim moves up only if it passes its direction's test in the protocol for comparing years. Otherwise it stays unproven, or is weakened.

agenda.deliverable: Condition-complete evidence table for the direction's anchors and challenge record.
acceptance: Resolve or explicitly bound missing fields for: dac-2026-research1110, dac-2026-research535, dac-2026-research865, iccad-2025-1027.
Keep condition extraction, source entailment, and scientific correctness as separate states.
Regenerate the direction page, dossier, and review gate.

operating_rules: A green validator proves repository consistency, not scientific acceptance.
A prepared packet is not a verdict.
A condition-complete record is not necessarily correct or independently reproduced.
A comparison dossier is not a trend claim until populations, denominators, and editions are matched.
